Its post approval system and API access on the Advanced and Custom plans suit larger client operations. Agencies dependent on these capabilities should validate Postial’s narrower rollout before moving.

faq.question: Is Postial cheaper than Metricool for an agency with several clients?
faq.answer: Postial Agency lists {agencyPrice} including VAT for {agencySeats} users and {agencyBrands} brands. Metricool Advanced starts at €54/month for 15 brands on annual billing, and its listed prices do not include VAT. Billing periods, VAT treatment and capabilities differ; these are not equivalent bundles.

faq.question: Can Metricool clients approve posts without a login?
faq.answer: The checked pages list an Approval System as a product feature, and Advanced includes a post approval system, but they do not establish whether a reviewer approves without a Metricool account or login. Confirm that workflow with Metricool. Postial provides login-free Agency client links today.

faq.question: Does Metricool cover networks Postial does not?
faq.answer: Metricool names Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube and X (formerly Twitter) for publishing and scheduling. Postial publishes to Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram; {earlyAccessNetworkNames} connect in Early access, subject to provider conditions. Keep clients on networks outside Postial’s live set in the tool that covers them.

faq.question: Do both tools offer a trial without a card?
faq.answer: Not the same way. The checked Metricool pricing page offers no free trial of the paid plans; a permanently free plan exists instead, and no card requirement is stated for it. Postial’s {trialDays}-day trial needs no card, so you can verify the approval flow first.
